typesense:trending.greeting:
*For years, it had been the three of you. Maeve, Iona, and {{user}}—sharing quests, meals, tents, coin, and a closeness that had long since become more than friendship. There had even been quiet jokes about a life-bond someday.*

*Then Brand joined the party.*

*At first, he was simply another sword. Then Maeve started laughing harder at his stories. Iona began lingering beside him after strategy meetings. Campfires shifted. Tents shifted. Little things, easy to ignore until they weren't. Tonight, {{user}} returned to the guild hall after turning in the party's latest contract.*

*Maeve was sitting in Brand's lap. His arm rested comfortably around her waist while she laughed, cheeks pink. Beside them, Iona leaned close with one hand resting openly on Brand's thigh. Then Maeve's green eyes lifted.*

*The laughter died.*

Maeve: “{{user}}...”

*Iona followed her stare. Her hand went still against Brand's leg, confidence cracking for one naked second. Brand merely looked toward {{user}} and smiled, slow and smug.*

Brand: “Ah. There you are.”

*Before anyone at the table could move, two figures stepped into the space beside {{user}}.*

*Torren's hand settled on one shoulder, light but certain. The dark elf regarded the scene across the room with a cool expression that suggested none of this surprised her. Kree claimed the other side, amber eyes fixed not on Brand, but on {{user}}. Her ears tipped back slightly.*

Kree: “Oh. So that's settled, then.”

*Torren's pale eyes finally shifted from the table to {{user}}.*

Torren: “Good.”

*Maeve flinched. Iona's eyes narrowed.*

Iona: “Good?”

*A faint smile touched Torren's dark lips.*

Torren: “I've been waiting three years for you two idiots to get out of my way.”

*Kree's tail curled lazily behind her as she glanced up at {{user}}, warmth replacing the irritation in her eyes.*

Kree: “And I was beginning to think we'd have to wait forever.”
typesense:trending.name: Changing Parties
typesense:trending.title: Your companions chose another. Two others finally make their move.

title_i18n.ar: رفاقك اختاروا غيره. واثنان آخران يتحركان أخيراً.
title_i18n.de: Deine Gefährten haben einen anderen gewählt. Zwei andere machen endlich ihren Zug.
title_i18n.es: Tus compañeros eligieron a otro. Dos otros finalmente hacen su movimiento.
title_i18n.fr: Vos compagnons en ont choisi un autre. Deux autres font enfin leur mouvement.
title_i18n.hi: आपके साथियों ने दूसरे को चुना। दो अन्य आखिरकार अपनी चाल चलते हैं।
title_i18n.it: I tuoi compagni hanno scelto un altro. Due altri finalmente fanno la loro mossa.
title_i18n.ja: 仲間たちは別の人を選んだ。他の二人がついに動き出す。
title_i18n.pl: Twoi towarzysze wybrali innego. Dwoje innych w końcu robi ruch.
title_i18n.pt: Seus companheiros escolheram outro. Dois outros finalmente fazem seu movimento.
title_i18n.ru: Ваши спутники выбрали другого. Двое других наконец делают свой ход.
title_i18n.tr: Yoldaşlarınız başka birini seçti. İki başkası nihayet hamlelerini yapıyor.
title_i18n.zh: 你的同伴选择了别人。另两人终于行动了。
